title: FlightPath Prompt Schema
description: Schema for FlightPath prompts. Prompts should be in final-form format with all context references (e.g., @path/to/file, @path/to/dir/, #file:path, #selection:path:line-line, #sym:path:symbol:line) included directly in the prompt text. FlightPath expands these references into inline file/symbol content before sending to the AI.

finalPrompt.description: A prompt that always runs after all queued prompts complete. If mcpServers includes "flightpath" and the finalPrompt appends prompts, those prompts run before finalPrompt executes again.

originalFile.description: Path to original prompt file (working files only)

startedAt.description: Timestamp when workflow started (working files only)

executionProperties.description: Shared execution configuration properties used across workflow-level defaults, prompt-level overrides, and runtime metadata

harness.description: Harness to use for this prompt. Determines which AI CLI or chat integration executes the prompt. Optional - defaults to flightpath.harness setting.

model.description: AI model to use for this prompt. Use IntelliSense (Ctrl+Space) to see available models. Each harness supports different models — unsupported models fall back to the harness default with a warning. Use 'none' to skip the --model flag entirely (e.g. for custom Bedrock model strings passed via additionalArgs). Optional - defaults to the active harness model setting.

agent.description: Custom agent to use for this prompt. Specify ONLY the agent name without file extensions (e.g., 'flightpath-orchestrator' for file 'flightpath-orchestrator.agent.md'). The agent's instructions will be prepended to your prompt using <agentInstructions> tags. Agents are discovered from .github/agents/, .claude/agents/, or user prompts directory. Works with all providers (Copilot CLI, Claude CLI, Codex CLI, Copilot Chat). Use null to explicitly disable inherited agent selection.

resumeSession.description: Whether to resume the existing chat session for this prompt. When omitted, defaults to the flightpath.resumeExistingSession setting (default: false). Set to true to continue in the existing session for context continuity. Retries continue in the same session by default; set endCondition.resumeSessionOnRetry=false to start a fresh session for each retry.

oneOf.description: A well-known MCP server ID (e.g., "flightpath" to enable dynamic queue extension).
MCP servers to attach. Include "flightpath" to enable dynamic queue extension.

mcpServers.description: MCP servers to attach to the harness for this prompt/workflow. Include "flightpath" to enable dynamic queue extension via FlightPath's MCP server. Use null to explicitly disable inherited servers.

sessionId.description: Session ID for resuming CLI conversations. Can be: a string (exact CLI session ID to resume), a number (prompt reference: 1 = use session from first prompt), or the special value "finalPrompt" (resume the session established by the most recent finalPrompt execution — works on any prompt, not just the finalPrompt item; on first pass when no finalPrompt session exists yet, a new session starts). When omitted and resumeSession=true, automatically resumes previous prompt's session. Working file runtime metadata stores the actual session ID used during execution.

skills.description: List of skill names to attach to this prompt. Only the skill frontmatter is attached (progressive disclosure) — the harness reads the full SKILL.md when using the skill. Skills are discovered from .claude/skills/ directories (workspace and user home). Prompt-level skills replace workflow-level skills (no merging). Use null to explicitly disable inherited skills.

endCondition.description: End condition validation to run after this prompt completes. Use null to explicitly disable end condition inheritance from the workflow level (even if the workflow defines one). Omitting this field inherits the workflow-level end condition (if any).

priorContext.description: Controls injection of prior prompt outputs into this prompt's text before sending to the AI. 'all' injects all prior outputs; 'previous' injects the immediately preceding output; 'none' disables injection; an array of integers ([1, 3]) injects specific prompts by 1-based index. When omitted, no context is injected. Note: combining with resumeSession:true may duplicate context (accepted limitation).

oneOf.description: Keyword shorthand: 'all' = all prior queue prompt outputs, 'previous' = immediately preceding queue prompt output, 'none' = no injection, 'finalPromptAll' = all previous finalPrompt loop outputs, 'finalPromptPrevious' = immediately preceding finalPrompt loop output
Specific prior prompt numbers to include (1-based, e.g. [1, 3] includes prompts 1 and 3)

additionalArgs.description: Additional CLI flags appended to FlightPath's standard argument set. FlightPath continues to manage model, permissions, workspace dirs, and session flags normally. Tokens are injected before the tool permission args. Applies only to CLI harnesses (copilot-cli, claude-cli, codex-cli, opencode-cli). Ignored for copilot-chat. Use null at prompt level to explicitly disable additional args even if the workflow or settings define some. Example: "--effort high --max-turns 10"

oneOf.description: Per-workflow/prompt tool permission overrides. Follows three-tier precedence: prompt > workflow > global VS Code settings. Only applies to CLI harnesses.

mode.description: Permission mode. 'dangerouslyAllowAll' bypasses all restrictions. 'allowAll' auto-grants all but respects deny list. 'custom' uses allowedTools + deniedTools only. 'passthrough' omits all FlightPath permission flags — the harness uses whatever permissions the user has configured in its own local settings (e.g. ~/.claude/settings.json, Copilot CLI config).

allowedTools.description: Tool patterns to allow (used in custom mode). Uses Copilot CLI format — auto-converted for Claude/Qwen. Ignored by Codex, OpenCode, and Gemini (mode-only harnesses).

deniedTools.description: Tool patterns to deny (takes precedence over allow list). Ignored by Codex, OpenCode, and Gemini (mode-only harnesses).

toolPermissions.description: Tool permission overrides for this prompt/workflow. Use null to explicitly disable inherited overrides and fall back to global VS Code settings. Set mode to 'passthrough' to omit all FlightPath permission flags and rely entirely on the harness's own local configuration.

name.description: Optional human-readable display label shown in the FlightPath dashboard. If omitted, the dashboard shows a truncated preview of the prompt text.

prompt.description: The prompt text to send to the AI. Can be either: (1) Final-form prompt text with context references expanded inline before sending — use @path/to/file or @path/to/dir/ for files/directories, and #file:path, #selection:path:line-line, or #sym:path:symbol:line for file excerpts and symbols. OR (2) A file path to a .prompt.md, .md, or .txt file containing the prompt. File paths are resolved relative to the prompt file's directory, then workspace root, then .flightpath directory. Absolute paths are also supported.

_runtime.description: Per-prompt runtime execution metadata (optional, added automatically during execution)

script.description: Path to script file to execute, or direct shell command (e.g., 'npm test', 'python script.py'). File paths are resolved relative to workspace root or .flightpath directory.

returns.description: Expected output from script (stdout). Matching rules: (1) Exact match (case-insensitive), (2) Boolean: 'true' matches true/1/yes/pass/passed, 'false' matches false/0/no/fail/failed, (3) Numeric: compared as >= (e.g., '90' matches if script outputs 90 or higher), (4) Substring: matches if output contains this string

maxRetries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts when validation fails. Use -1 for unlimited retries (use with caution), 0 for no retries (default), or 1-100 for a specific limit.

retryPrompt.description: Template for retry prompt with placeholders: {scriptOutput}, {errorOutput}, {expectedValue}, {actualValue}, {retryCount}, {maxRetries}

resumeSessionOnRetry.description: Whether retries continue in the same session. Default: true (retries resume the existing session for context continuity). Set to false to start a fresh session for each retry.

promptRuntimeMetadata.description: Per-prompt runtime execution metadata (optional, added automatically during execution)

startedAt.description: Timestamp when this prompt started execution

completedAt.description: Timestamp when this prompt completed execution (set for all terminal states, not just successful completion)

terminalStatus.description: Terminal state of this prompt. Absent or 'completed' means successful completion. Used to restore the correct visual status after a working file reload.

retryCount.description: Number of retry attempts for this prompt

responseText.description: Plain-text AI response from this prompt's execution. Written automatically during workflow execution. Used by the priorContext feature to inject prior prompt outputs.

runtimeMetadata.description: Workflow-level runtime execution state for working files (optional, added automatically by FlightPath during execution)

finalPrompt.description: Runtime metadata for finalPrompt execution state (optional, added automatically during execution)

responseTexts.description: Response texts from each finalPrompt loop execution, indexed by loop number (0-based). Written automatically during workflow execution. Used by the priorContext 'finalPromptAll' and 'finalPromptPrevious' keywords.

mcpServerConfig.description: User-defined MCP server configuration for attaching external MCP servers to harness invocations.

command.description: Command to run the MCP server (e.g., "node", "python")

args.description: Arguments to pass to the command

env.description: Environment variables for the server process

autoApprove.description: Tools to auto-approve: true = all tools, string[] = specific tools
